fact: For January to December 2018 the study states that health facilities in Chad report HMIS data on paper forms to the health district, where data from health centres and district hospitals are converted to Excel by the zonal chief or district manager, and it measures HMIS reporting completeness of 95.24% across 14 health centres in Massaguet district.
title: Health management information system (HMIS) data quality and associated factors in Massaguet district, Chad
publisher: BMC Medical Informatics and Decision Making
